This diptych merges the Amazon rainforest with the human lung. The bronzed, textured form filling each frame mirrors the shape of a lung, while delicate bare branches extend inward like bronchial passages stripped of life.

Quadraria e Poesia was born from the creative partnership of Guilherme Rueda, a poet who published his first poetry collection in 2020, and Rafael Daltôe, a visual artist and architect. Every piece is 100% original and handcrafted, made one by one. Poetry made physical.

Acquired at Galeria Alma da Rua, the gallery and cultural hub at the heart of Beco do Batman — São Paulo’s iconic open-air street art district in Vila Madalena.

“Coração que pulsa, pulmão que respira, a alma que nos dá vida” — “A heart that beats, a lung that breathes, the soul that gives us life.”
